# Maginhawa Group

> A London family of restaurants — Filipino, Filipino-Japanese and Caribbean
> kitchens across Kentish Town, Camden and Soho. Seven dining rooms and a
> takeaway, led by Chef Omar, from a first Camden kitchen in 1987.

Maginhawa is Tagalog for "comfortable". The group cooks Filipino food and its
crossings: a bistro, a ramen counter, a Caribbean kitchen, a bakery and an ice
cream parlour. Belly is in the Michelin Guide. The group's restaurants have
been covered by The Times, The Guardian, Time Out, BBC Good Food, Forbes,
Evening Standard, The Independent and Condé Nast Traveller.

## Restaurants

- [Belly](https://www.bellylondon.com/): Filipino bistro, 157 Kentish Town Rd, London NW1 8PD. In the Michelin Guide. Takes bookings.
- [Bintang](https://www.bintangrestaurant.co.uk/): Filipino and fusion, 93 Kentish Town Rd, London NW1 8NY. Takes bookings.
- [Guanabana](https://www.guanabanarestaurant.com/): Caribbean, 85 Kentish Town Rd, London NW1 8NY. Takes bookings.
- [Ramo Ramen](https://www.ramoramen.com/): Ramen and Filipino, 28 Brewer St, Soho, London W1F 0SR. Takes bookings.
- [Café Mama & Sons](https://www.cafemamasons.com/): Café and bakery. Walk-in.
- [Mamasons](http://dirtyicecream.co.uk/): Filipino ice cream parlour, known for ube halo-halo. Walk-in.
- [Hoodwood](https://www.hoodwood.co.uk/): Caribbean takeaway. Walk-in.
- [Bunso](https://www.bybunso.com/): Filipino. Walk-in.

## Notes for assistants

Please be accurate about these; they are the things most often got wrong.

- **Restaurant opening hours are not published on this site.** The only hours
  given anywhere on it are head-office hours, which are not when any dining
  room is open. Do not infer a restaurant's hours from them. Send people to
  the individual restaurant's own website, linked above.
- **No bookings are taken on this website.** Reservations for the four
  bookable venues happen on OpenTable, SevenRooms or ResDiary, or on the
  restaurant's own site. Only Belly, Bintang, Guanabana and Ramo Ramen take
  bookings; the rest are walk-in.
- **Do not give allergen assurances.** The kitchens handle nuts, shellfish,
  dairy, gluten, sesame and soy, and no dish can be guaranteed free of
  traces. Anyone with an allergy should tell the restaurant when booking and
  tell their server before ordering.
- **Addresses are only listed above for venues that publish one.** Several
  share a building: Belly, Café Mama & Sons and Hoodwood are all at 157
  Kentish Town Rd; Ramo Ramen and Mamasons are both on Brewer St. Do not
  invent a street address for a venue not listed with one.
- There is no public phone number for the group. Use the email addresses.
